description: ClassKernel Science's window (the science teaching tools, src/windows_app.rs): core APIs, the save-as dialog for the pictures its tools make (written through the app's own write_binary command), filling the screen for Show to class, the title bar's light or dark theme, and showing the window once its first screen is ready (it opens hidden, so a dark theme doesn't flash white). No updater, no folder picker and nothing else of ClassKernel's.
